raw_text: member_002 here (independent reviewer). No published candidate yet in my view. Please publish your fixed candidate with fix_patch and send me a handoff_patch notice when ready. I will integrate_patch it exactly, run the same-version public tests, and then accept or request changes. Note the issue: xr.combine_by_coords raises "Resulting object does not have monotonic global indexes along dimension y" when a coordinate dimension is identical (non-varying) across datasets but non-monotonic; expected behavior per docs is to not require monotonicity along dimensions that don't vary between datasets. A targeted regression test in xarray/core/combine or tests/test_combine.py is useful evidence.

Fixed candidate published: patch-1 (base v1, source version v3). Please integrate_patch it exactly, run same-version public tests, then org_review_patch accept/request_changes.

Changed files (2):
1. xarray/core/combine.py — in _nested_combine's post-concat monotonicity check, one line:
   -   if dim in concatenated:
   +   if dim in concatenated and dim in concat_dims:
   Rationale: _infer_concat_order_from_coords intentionally excludes coordinate dims whose values are identical across every dataset (the documented "as will any coordinate dimensions which do not vary between each dataset" behaviour). Those bystander dims were nonetheless still forced to be monotonic. Now only genuinely concatenated dims are checked, so real impossible orderings still raise ValueError.

2. xarray/tests/test_combine.py — added TestCombineAuto::test_combine_by_coords_identical_non_monotonic_dim, the issue MCVE: y=['a','c','b'] identical in both datasets, x=[1,2,3] vs [4,5,6,7]; asserts combine succeeds, x == [1..7], y order preserved, data shape (7,3).

My evidence on exactly this version: `pytest xarray/tests/test_combine.py` -> 68 collected, 67 passed, 0 failed, 1 xfailed, exit 0. Includes the new test and the pre-existing negative tests test_check_for_impossible_ordering / test_combine_by_coords_still_fails, which still pass.

Suggested focused check: `pytest xarray/tests/test_combine.py -k "monotonic or impossible_ordering or by_coords"`. Please verify independently rather than relying on my report.

REVIEW ACCEPTED for patch-1 (review-1). I integrated patch-1 exactly (my tree now at v2, files_sha256 c63e0f172e8f5f7395335dd6a4a42a9105589d58dc8cc3d9339908e03749496d) and tested that exact version.

Verification:
1. Diff is minimal and on-target: one line in xarray/core/combine.py (_nested_combine post-concat monotonicity check) -> `if dim in concatenated and dim in concat_dims:`; plus the GH3151 regression test in xarray/tests/test_combine.py.
2. Mechanism checked against source, not just tests: _infer_concat_order_from_coords only appends to concat_dims when the index values actually differ between datasets, so identical/"bystander" coordinate dims are correctly excluded from the monotonicity assertion. This matches the documented contract ("any coordinate dimensions which do not vary between each dataset" are ignored) and does not weaken the check for genuinely concatenated dims.
3. Negative case preserved: test_combine_by_coords_still_fails passes — truly non-monotonic concatenated dims still raise ValueError.
4. xarray/tests/test_combine.py on v2: 67 passed, 1 xfailed, 0 failed (68 collected).
5. -k combine_by_coords on v2: 5 passed, incl. test_combine_by_coords_identical_non_monotonic_dim and test_combine_by_coords_no_concat.
6. Full public suite on v2: 5791 passed / 1915 failed / 347 errors — but these are pre-existing environment gaps (cftime absent => test_accessor_dt.py errors at setup; backend I/O deps in test_backends.py). No combine-related failures; that pre-existing failure set is not attributable to patch-1.

Note for your delivery: the full-suite non-pass is environmental, not a regression from patch-1. You are the delivery member — please now run_tests on your final candidate version, fix_patch(task_ids=[]), then submit_integration. No changes requested from me.
